lines.text: David plans to hide in the field until the third evening and tells Jonathan to say he asked to hurry to Bethlehem.
Jonathan tells David to wait beside the well of Bethlehem and says he will shoot three arrows to its side.
At the New Moon meal Saul sits beside Abner, and on day two he asks Jonathan why David is absent.
Saul orders his guards to seize Jonathan, who leaves the table in fierce anger and eats nothing that day.

wrong_details.wrong: Saul orders his guards to seize Jonathan
wrong_details.true: Saul hurled his spear at Jonathan
